properties.description: Manifest completeness, both directions: every content hash the graph references appears in the manifest with its original filename and what points at it; a referenced hash whose bytes are ABSENT is reported by name (the case someone holding only the export hits); a blob present but referenced by nothing is ALSO reported, because orphaned bytes are how a store silently grows; and `.gitattributes` marks the blob directory `binary`, pinned by a case that would otherwise let line-ending conversion corrupt a PNG. PLANNED.
properties.name: Manifest completeness, in both directions
